description: MCP server providing semantic Java code analysis for AI agents. Built on Eclipse JDT with tools for navigation, refactoring, search, and metrics.

tool_signatures.name: analyze_change_impact
tool_signatures.description: Blast radius — direct call sites by depth, or the full transitive closure over the project graph (transitive=true)

tool_signatures.name: analyze_control_flow
tool_signatures.description: Branching, loops, return/throw points, nesting depth

tool_signatures.name: analyze_data_flow
tool_signatures.description: Variable read/write/declaration tracking within a method; opt-in followCalls tracks null/taint facts across calls to sinks

tool_signatures.name: analyze_file
tool_signatures.description: Get imports, types, diagnostics in one call

tool_signatures.name: apply_cleanup
tool_signatures.description: Apply one of 10 JDT clean-ups (convert loops, pattern matching, switch expressions, text blocks, ...) and return rewritten source

tool_signatures.name: apply_quick_fix
tool_signatures.description: Apply fix by ID (add import, remove import, add throws, try-catch)

tool_signatures.name: diagnose_and_fix
tool_signatures.description: Diagnose a file and return each problem's top quick-fix edits in one call

tool_signatures.name: encapsulate_field
tool_signatures.description: Generate accessors and rewrite all direct field accesses

tool_signatures.name: extract_method
tool_signatures.description: Extract code block to new method

tool_signatures.name: extract_superclass
tool_signatures.description: Move a member into a newly created superclass

tool_signatures.name: find_affected_tests
tool_signatures.description: The tests that exercise a symbol, directly or transitively — the set to run after changing it

tool_signatures.name: find_circular_dependencies
tool_signatures.description: Detect package cycles using Tarjan's SCC algorithm

tool_signatures.name: find_large_classes
tool_signatures.description: Find types exceeding method/field/line count thresholds

tool_signatures.name: find_possible_bugs
tool_signatures.description: Detect null risks, empty catches, resource leaks

tool_signatures.name: find_references
tool_signatures.description: Find all usages of a symbol

tool_signatures.name: find_reflection_usage
tool_signatures.description: Find Class.forName(), Method.invoke(), and other reflection calls

tool_signatures.name: find_throws_declarations
tool_signatures.description: Find all throws Exception in signatures

tool_signatures.name: find_unreachable_code
tool_signatures.description: Project-wide dead code — members unreachable from any main method or test, over the whole-program call graph

tool_signatures.name: get_call_hierarchy_incoming
tool_signatures.description: Find all callers of a method

tool_signatures.name: get_call_hierarchy_outgoing
tool_signatures.description: Find all methods called by a method

tool_signatures.name: get_dependency_graph
tool_signatures.description: Package/type dependencies as nodes and edges

tool_signatures.name: get_document_symbols
tool_signatures.description: Get all symbols in a file

tool_signatures.name: get_http_endpoints
tool_signatures.description: Assembled HTTP route table — Spring and JAX-RS paths composed from class prefixes, mapped to handler methods

tool_signatures.name: get_jpa_model
tool_signatures.description: Assembled JPA entity model — tables, id fields, relationships with resolved targets and mappedBy sides

tool_signatures.name: get_quick_fixes
tool_signatures.description: List available fixes for problem at position

tool_signatures.name: get_signature_help
tool_signatures.description: Get method signature at call site

tool_signatures.name: get_symbol_info
tool_signatures.description: Get detailed symbol information at position

tool_signatures.name: introduce_parameter_object
tool_signatures.description: Bundle a method's parameters into a new class, updating callers

tool_signatures.name: move_type_to_new_file
tool_signatures.description: Move a nested type into its own top-level file

tool_signatures.name: pull_up
tool_signatures.description: Move a member into the superclass

tool_signatures.name: push_down
tool_signatures.description: Move a member into the subclasses

tool_signatures.name: search_symbols
tool_signatures.description: Search types, methods, fields by glob pattern

tool_signatures.name: suggest_imports
tool_signatures.description: Find import candidates for unresolved type
